fields.Fee estimate basis:
ESTIMATE — constant-price two-year academic reference, not an official total or all-in budget. Published first-year/annual amount ₹393,800; annual tuition ₹2,71,400 (₹1,35,700 × two instalments). Low ₹665,200 = full first-year amount plus second-year tuition only, so it is a component floor. High ₹784,600 = twice annual amount less known ₹3,000 one-time alumni membership. This only varies recurrence of non-tuition components; it does not bound future fee rises. Hostel, transport, future revisions and unlisted charges excluded. Source cycle: 2027–28 table; current programme page also confirms first-year amount.
Conditional fee low ₹L: 6.652; Conditional fee high ₹L: 7.846
